notes.title: Minor bug fixes, additions and balance changes
notes.notes:
Pathogen EAv1.0.01

MINOR ADDITIONS

Added Thanatus and Radion personalized Croaker messages when they get discovered
Added a new visual effect for passive infections
Added new Croaker account images

MINOR BUG FIXES

Scroll sensitivity adjusted on all menus
Fixed a bug where you could start an empty tutorial by not selecting one
Fixed Croaker mortality rate percentage
Adjusted floating text to not display If the value is 0
Fixed Radion special upgrade tree prices
Fixed gridTag not properly updating at certain circumstances
Removed "Observer" role from multiplayer
Fixed Steam Achievements for won games
Fixed some Steam Achievements being hidden by mistake

BALANCE CHANGES

Reduced the cost of the Radion special upgrade tree
Increased infectious radiation effectiveness
Infecting during a flag event now always set its outbreak to max
Starting on a flag now sets its outbreak to max
Black death nerfed/reworked
Active infections produce twice the outbreak as before
Fixed a bug where you could start an empty tutorial by not selecting one
Units no longer lose pathogens when entering a flag

notes.title: Early Access release and future updates
notes.notes:
Finally, Pathogen got released, after 3 years of development!

This is the absolute first version of the game, so many bugs and bad stuff are expected, especially on multiplater. Please, when you find any bugs, report them on the "Bug reports" forum on Steam discussions.

My plans for future updates are (subject to change):

First updates prioritizing major bugs, then minor bugs, and improving gameplay aspects according to feedback from the community. Also adding Challenges.
When the game gets to a better state, the update for the Prion, a new regular plague type.
An update adding some type of in-game currency and a shop to use that currency (don't worry, no in-app purchases). Also, small additions based on feedback from the community.
Finally, the update including the 3rd superplague. This will conclude the Early Access roadmap.

Please, remember the game is in Early Access, so im really open to suggestions. I really want to focus my development on listening my community. I want to make a game that everyone can enjoy :)

Best wishes for everyone 🧡
